termsAndConditions: 50% advance payment required to commence work. Balance 40% on material delivery and 10% on completion.
Quoted prices are valid for 30 days from the date of quotation.
Any variation in dimensions or specifications after work order issuance will attract additional charges.
Civil / plumbing / electrical work is not included unless specifically mentioned in the quotation.
Delivery and installation timeline will be confirmed at the time of order placement.
All materials supplied by the company carry manufacturer warranty. Labour warranty is 1 year from completion.
GST at applicable rates is included in the above amounts.
Disputes, if any, shall be subject to Mumbai jurisdiction.
